DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_BirdDragon_Ice:
The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a <characterName id=|BirdDragon_Ice|/> 
are said to cross whole mountain ranges.
In ages past, such flutes were used to signal victory in battle.

Lays <itemName id=|Egg| style=|Status_Keyword|/>'s when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_BirdDragon_Ice:
Can be ridden as a flying mount.

While in party, 
increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

Lays <itemName id=|Egg| style=|Status_Keyword|/>'s when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
